name: Learn
description: Courses researched and planned as skill trees, a live teacher in every lesson, exercises, cards that come back when you are about to forget them, experience, levels, a streak, study times and lesson todos.

content.text: Courses, steps, cards, conversations and what you earned. The app is the Learn view of Courses.

views.name: Learn
views.template:
<state name="course" value=""/>
<data name="courses" flow="learn.courses" with="n=0"/>
<data name="map" flow="learn.map" with="course={{ state.course }}"/>
<header title="{{ db.title }}" subtitle="{{ rows | count }}" icon="🪜"/>
<row gap=2 wrap=true>{{#each data.courses.courses}}<button action="state" state="course" value="{{ title }}" label="{{ title }}" variant="{{ title == data.map.course ? 'primary' : 'plain' }}"/>{{/each}}</row>
<graph look="map" source="data.map.nodes" groups="data.map.groups" route="data.map.route" label="Skill map" empty="No course with a plan yet. Start one on the Learn page."/>
